title: EEG: Improvisation and Musical Structures
description: EEG recordings from musicians listening to three-chord progressions in an auditory oddball-style paradigm. Standard progressions were interspersed with exemplar deviants (different chord inversion) and function deviants (different harmonic function of the middle chord). The dataset supports investigation of how improvisational experience relates to the categorization of musical structures.
methods_description: Each trial was a three-chord progression (ii-IV-I, ii-V-I, ii-IV6-I, or ii-V6-I) with piano timbre, 400 ms per chord plus 400 ms silence (1600 ms total). Each block had 180 trials with one progression as standard and 7.5% each of exemplar and function deviants. Every block type occurred twice, giving eight blocks per subject in shuffled order and 1440 trials in total. The key of each trial was chosen at random.
